candidates.why_relevant: The dominant Czech startup/business/tech outlet. Confirmed rubric structure includes /byznys/, /startupy/, /investice/, /e-commerce/, /krypto/, /tech/ and a rolling /live/ newswire. This is where Czech payments and fintech funding rounds, product launches and bank-fintech partnerships are typically reported first, often months before any regulated disclosure. Also profiles founders and investors of companies too young to file meaningful annual reports.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll section indexes (/live/, /startupy/, /investice/, /byznys/, /e-commerce/) plus on-site search; extract headline, URL, date, named entities. Check for an RSS endpoint — none was exposed on the homepage HTML I retrieved. Store only headline + link + short excerpt, not full text, to stay inside fair-use/quotation limits.

candidates.why_relevant: A time-stamped rolling feed of short Czech business/startup/tech items, updated multiple times per day (items observed at 06:33, 07:16, 11:04 on the fetch date). This is the highest-cadence weak-signal channel on CzechCrunch: short launch/partnership/funding notices land here that never become full features. Confirmed to carry fintech items — e.g. 'Fintech Roger loni rostl o 40 procent, profinancoval faktury za téměř 13 miliard korun' and 'ČSOB a Mastercard vybraly do Fintech Challenge šest startupů', both under the /live/ path.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: High-frequency polling (2-4x/day) of the /live/ index; the feed is timestamped so diffing on URL is reliable. Filter on a Czech+English payments/fintech keyword list.

candidates.why_relevant: CzechCrunch does not appear to expose a dedicated /fintech/ tag archive (see negative findings), so on-site search is the practical entry point into its fintech back-catalogue. The query 'fintech' returned 38 results with a clean pagination pattern (https://cc.cz/page/N/?s=fintech), and the result set itself acts as an actor map: Roger, Sype.to, ČSOB, Mastercard, Fintech Week CEE, Fintech Challenge all surfaced from one query.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Run a rotating Czech keyword set through ?s= and paginate via /page/N/?s=; use as a discovery/backfill mechanism and as an entity-extraction feed, not as a daily monitor.

candidates.why_relevant: 201-episode Czech business podcast hosted by Ondřej Holzman and Luboš Kreč, interviewing figures shaping Czech business and markets. Long-form interview format regularly surfaces founder/investor detail — strategy, valuations, expansion plans — that never appears in written coverage or filings. Observed episodes include algorithmic-trading founders (Martin Schmid / EquiLibre, Petr Zahradník / Qminers) and acquisition financiers (Pavel Drobil / Anacot Capital). Episode pages carry text summaries, so they are machine-readable without audio transcription.
candidates.access_status: open_web; also distributed on YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape episode index pages for title, guest, date, URL and the written summary; only transcribe audio for episodes whose guest matches the payments/banking actor list.

candidates.why_relevant: The single best-curated Czech-language fintech archive found in this cell: a working topic page with 101 articles across 4 pages, pagination via ?pi=N. Headlines observed are exactly the target signal type — 'Direct Fidoo ... spouští platformu pro malé a střední podniky' (17.6.2026), Revolut at 1.2m Czech users (24.3.2026), Wflow passing CZK 100m ARR (26.2.2026), and 'Česko má první sandbox pro fintechové startupy, otevřelo ho 21 projektům' (4.2.2026). Lupa is published in the Internet Info stable (shares the /do-mailu/ newsletter infrastructure with Měšec.cz), and is editorially serious about telecom/IT/fintech infrastructure.
candidates.access_status: open_web with an optional 'Lupa+' subscription tier (https://www.lupa.cz/podporte/); topic index and headlines observed freely
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_editorial_content; partial paywall on some items
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the topic index with ?pi= pagination for backfill, then switch to the site RSS feed for ongoing monitoring. Record title/date/URL and named entities; respect the Lupa+ paywall by not circumventing it.

candidates.why_relevant: 127 articles across 5 pages, and the densest pure-payments Czech-language stream located in this cell. Observed headlines cover exactly the A1-adjacent weak signals: Apple leading Czech digital-subscription payments (31.7.2026), 'Fidoo z Directu chce být vrstvou nad bankami' (17.6.2026), Mastercard + ČSOB testing AI-driven shopping in Czechia (6.5.2026), Huawei watches gaining contactless (13.4.2026), and a DDoS attack on the PayU payment gateway (2.4.2026). Covers gateways, acquirers, wallets and bank-scheme partnerships — the merchant-integration layer that regulated disclosures never describe.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Same as the fintech archive: paginated backfill via ?pi=, then RSS for deltas. Cross-join entity extraction with the /n/fintech/ and /n/bankovnictvi/ archives to build a Czech payments actor map.

candidates.why_relevant: 34 articles; smaller than the payments archive but distinctly focused on bank-side technology, fraud and channel innovation. Observed items include Komerční banka reporting rising cyber-fraud losses (22.4.2026), a Czech surge in authorised-push-payment style phone fraud (2.2.2026), Revolut launching in-app caller verification against bank-impersonation fraud (13.1.2026), Česká spořitelna opening an AI/VR-equipped nonstop branch (12.11.2025), and quarterly bank cyber-attack volumes (5.5.2025). Useful for tracking bank technology strategy and fraud-driven product launches.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl (weekly) given the smaller volume; merge into the same Lupa pipeline as /n/fintech/ and /n/platby/.

candidates.why_relevant: A machine-readable RSS 2.0 feed (MRSS namespace, 20 items, author attribution, enclosure images, persistent GUIDs) confirmed live and current to 25.8.2026. This is the cheapest, most robust ingestion path for the whole Lupa corpus and removes any need to scrape topic pages for ongoing monitoring. Its existence also implies analogous /rss/ endpoints across the Internet Info network (Měšec.cz, Podnikatel.cz), which is worth probing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Standard RSS poller on a 1-3 hour cadence with GUID-based dedup; keyword-filter the item titles/descriptions against the Czech payments glossary before storing.

candidates.why_relevant: Interview podcast running since mid-2018 with e-commerce, IT and media figures. Fintech-relevant episodes exist but are a minority — the most on-point observed was Jan Blažek of Bankovní identita on the European digital identity wallet (29.11.2024), which is directly load-bearing for Czech payments/authentication infrastructure. Each episode has a full article page with a text write-up, so it is text-collectable.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the episode index monthly; only pull episodes whose guest/company matches the Czech banking-and-payments actor list.

candidates.why_relevant: Forbes CZ is explicitly named in this coverage cell. The /tag/fintech/ path resolved and returned a page header reading 'Fintech ▶ ... s Forbes Česko | Forbes', confirming a fintech tag exists and that the tag URL pattern is /tag/<slug>/. Forbes CZ specialises in founder/investor profiles and rich-list style wealth reporting, which names the people and capital behind young Czech payments companies. NOTE: the site renders its article lists client-side — three separate fetches (homepage, /technologie/, /tag/fintech/) each returned only a header line and no article list, so the tag's contents are unverified.
candidates.access_status: partially_unreadable_by_plain_http_fetch (JS-rendered listings); subscription tier not confirmed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use a headless-browser renderer rather than plain HTTP fetch. Probe for an RSS feed and a sitemap.xml first — either would remove the JS dependency. Confirm the tag slug list by rendering one article page and reading its tag links.
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 200 but response body contained only the page title/header; no article list or navigation was present in the served HTML on three separate paths.

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace — FinTech Spot (news section)
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech Fintech Association's own editorial feed, actively published (items observed dated 7.8.2026 through 20.8.2026, with archive depth back to October 2022). Mixes Czech and international fintech topics — euro stablecoins and ECB pushback, PayPal/Stripe/Advent deal talk, 'Patnáct unicornů ukazuje směr FinTechu', a CryptoNight Brno event listing. Because the association is industry-run, its editorial choices double as a signal of what the Czech fintech lobby is prioritising.
candidates.access_status: open_web; newsletter signup present ('Pravidelně zasíláme informace ze světa FinTech')
candidates.legal_status: association_published_content; treat as interested-party commentary, not neutral reporting
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of /clanky/ plus newsletter subscription. Tag every item as association-sourced so downstream analysis discounts advocacy framing.

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace — member directory (80+ members)
candidates.why_relevant: The highest-value pointer found in this cell: a directory the association describes as more than 80 members, with logos observed on the homepage for Aevi, Greco, Deloitte, Home Credit and Unnits Tech. This is a ready-made actor map for Czech fintech and payments — it names the companies whose funding rounds, launches and partnerships the media in this cell will report on, and it captures firms far too young to file meaningful annual reports. Aevi in particular is a payments-acceptance actor directly relevant to a POS/terminal-adjacent intelligence brief.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off full extraction to seed the actor/glossary map, then quarterly re-crawl and diff — joiners and leavers are themselves a signal. Cross-reference each member against the ČNB register of payment institutions and against the media archives above.

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace — Studie českého fintechu (sector study)
candidates.why_relevant: A recurring sector study quantifying Czech fintech employment and economic contribution — the project page cites 6,394 people employed including 1,603 foreigners, and public-revenue contribution figures. A companion CzechTrade export brochure (https://czechfintech.cz/project/10647/) describes Czech fintech as a sector with 'more than 200 active firms'. Together these give a defensible denominator for the sector and a second, larger company list beyond the 80+ members.
candidates.access_status: open_web; underlying PDF/report artefact not yet retrieved
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Retrieve the underlying study/brochure PDFs, extract the company list as an actor seed, and re-check annually for a new edition. Treat headline economic figures as advocacy-sourced and corroborate against ČSÚ/ČNB data.

candidates.source_name: Česká fintech asociace — tiskové zprávy (press releases)
candidates.why_relevant: First-party press releases from the sector body — the association speaking in its own voice on policy and governance. Confirmed items include the EET/voluntary-sales-record digitalisation position (11.5.2022) and the leadership change putting Miroslav Lukeš and Ondřej Machač at the head of the association (10.3.2022). Useful for tracking who speaks for Czech fintech and what the sector is lobbying for. Note: the two items I could confirm are both from 2022, so publication cadence on this specific category page looks low.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl; low volume. Note the URL inconsistency — the category index sits at /category/tiskove-zpravy/ while individual items resolve under /tiskove-zpravy/<slug>/.

candidates.why_relevant: The Czech banking trade magazine, published by 4H production s.r.o. (Prague), with a confirmed section structure of /banky-finance, /produkty-sluzby, /regulace, /technologie, /rozhovory, /eventy and /personalie. The /personalie section is a genuinely distinctive signal — executive appointments at Czech banks and payment firms, which nothing else in this cell tracks systematically. /technologie and /produkty-sluzby carry vendor-and-bank product launches; /rozhovory carries executive interviews. Print issues 5 and 7/8 of 2026 were visible, so it is current.
candidates.access_status: web sections appear open; print/digital subscription at /predplatne, free sample issue at /contact/magazine_preview, mobile app at /contact/aplikace
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_trade_press; subscription content must not be circumvented
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /technologie, /produkty-sluzby, /personalie and /regulace weekly. Consider a paid subscription for the print/PDF edition, which likely carries deeper vendor and RFP detail than the free web tier.

candidates.source_name: E15.cz — byznys sections (startupy, finance a bankovnictví, technologie a média)
candidates.why_relevant: E15 is a mainstream Czech business daily with a confirmed sub-rubric structure under /byznys/ that maps cleanly onto this cell: /startupy, /finance-a-bankovnictvi, /technologie-a-media, /obchod-a-sluzby. It also runs a consumer-finance vertical (/finexpert/, with /banky-ucty). The startup rubric plus the banking rubric together catch both the funding-round side and the incumbent-bank side of a payments partnership story. An RSS endpoint at /rss and podcasts at /podcasty/ were both confirmed present.
candidates.access_status: mixed — free plus an 'e15 Premium' paywall (/e15-premium, /predplatne)
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_editorial; premium tier must not be circumvented
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the /rss feed and filter by section path; crawl the three named sub-rubrics daily. Flag premium items by URL and store headline+deck only unless a subscription is purchased.

candidates.why_relevant: HN (publisher: Economia, a.s.) runs a subdomain-per-rubric structure with tech.hn.cz, byznys.hn.cz and investice.hn.cz all confirmed. It is the most reportorially resourced Czech business title, so it is where a bank-fintech partnership gets investigated rather than announced. A central RSS hub exists at https://rss.hn.cz/, a podcast hub at https://podcasty.hn.cz/ (including the money/investing show MoneyPenny and Krypto Insider), and named newsletters include 'Byznys' (weekly) and 'Peníze' (investment focus).
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_editorial; hard paywall on premium items
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Ingest https://rss.hn.cz/ and route by subdomain. A paid HN+ subscription is probably warranted for this cell given the depth of Czech banking coverage; do not attempt paywall circumvention. Archive search available at https://archiv.hn.cz/.

candidates.why_relevant: Czech business/economics portal with Finance, Investování, Technologie and Telekomunikace categories, an open RSS feed at https://www.peak.cz/feed/ and no observed paywall — which makes it unusually cheap to ingest relative to HN or E15. Its fintech/startup focus is thinner than CzechCrunch's, so treat it as breadth coverage and corroboration rather than a primary weak-signal channel. Category URLs follow /category/<topic>/ and author pages /authors/<name>/.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to https://www.peak.cz/feed/ and keyword-filter; no scraping needed.

candidates.why_relevant: Consumer-finance portal in the Internet Info stable (shares Lupa's /do-mailu/ newsletter infrastructure). Confirmed product-level sections for personal accounts, business accounts, charge cards and credit cards for both consumers and businesses (/produkty/charge-karty/, /produkty/kreditni-karty-pro-podnikatele/). Its value in this cell is different from the tech media: it tracks fee schedules, card product terms and account features at a granularity that reveals competitive moves before any press release does. No paywall observed.
candidates.access_status: open_web, no paywall observed; newsletter at /do-mailu/
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Probe for /rss/ by analogy with Lupa. Crawl /clanky/ for editorial and snapshot the /produkty/ comparison tables periodically to diff card and account terms over time.

candidates.why_relevant: SME-facing business portal (Internet Info stable) covering online payments, EET/sales-record digitalisation, business banking and e-commerce rules. It is the merchant-side mirror of this cell: where CzechCrunch reports a payments company raising money, Podnikatel reports what merchants are actually charged and how they integrate. Homepage articles observed on invoicing errors and on holding business accounts across multiple banks. It also bundles a company registry at /rejstrik/, which is a useful entity-resolution helper.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /clanky/ weekly with a merchant-payments keyword filter; probe for an RSS endpoint by analogy with Lupa. Use /rejstrik/ only as a lookup aid, not as a primary registry source.

candidates.why_relevant: Seznam Zprávy, a.s. (Seznam.cz group) is one of the largest-reach Czech news operations, with a confirmed section pattern /sekce/ekonomika-byznys-216 and article pattern /clanek/ekonomika-byznys-<slug>-<ID>. A separate Tech parent category exists. Reach matters here: a payments story that breaks on Seznam Zprávy sets the national narrative even when CzechCrunch had it first. No paywall was evident on the business magazine section. Note that the observed headline sample was consumer-magazine-ish rather than fintech, so treat fintech density as low.
candidates.access_status: open_web, no paywall evident on this section
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the section RSS feed (referenced but not enumerated in the HTML I retrieved) and filter on the numeric section ID. Use as a reach/salience signal rather than a primary discovery channel.

candidates.why_relevant: A Czech-language fintech/personal-finance blog that self-describes as covering 'fintech inovacích a trendy technologiích'. Confirmed sections: Akcie a kryptoměny, Bankovnictví a účty, Daně a osobní finance, Důchody a penzijní spoření, Hypotéky, Spoření a investice, Spotřebitelské úvěry a půjčky. It does name specific Czech institutions (Česká spořitelna, ČSOB funds, Moneta mortgages). IMPORTANT CAVEAT: despite the name, the observed content is retail financial-education and product-comparison material with likely affiliate monetisation, not fintech-industry reporting — credibility is scored down accordingly and it is not a substitute for CzechCrunch/Lupa.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_blog_content; commercial/affiliate incentives likely — treat as promotional
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-priority monthly crawl of the Bankovnictví a účty section only. Never use as a sole source for a factual claim; corroborate anything it reports.

candidates.why_relevant: Official state startup-ecosystem platform under CzechInvest (the old czechstartups.org now 301-redirects here). It exposes structured directories — startups at /startup-ekosystem/startupy/, investors at /startup-ekosystem/investori/, ecosystem data at /startup-data/ and support programmes at /programy/ — and advertises 44 investors, 208 startup infrastructures and 300 events per year. As a pointer this is the state-sanctioned counterpart to the association member list: it names the investors whose portfolio announcements the media in this cell will report.
candidates.legal_status: public_sector_information; generally reusable, check site terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off extraction of the startup and investor directories to seed the actor map, then quarterly diff. Filter the startup directory to fintech/payments SIC-equivalents and join against the Czech Fintech Association member list.

candidates.why_relevant: Satisfies the English-language leg of this cell. Confirmed live tag page carrying Czech funding-round coverage — Sloneek's EUR 3.6m round, ZAKA's EUR 15m Fund I, Elin.ai's EUR 1m pre-seed, Rohlik's EUR 100m unicorn round, Canva's acquisition of Smartmockups — plus an explicit piece on the Czech VC market 'getting more professional'. Deal sizes are given in EUR, which makes cross-country normalisation easy, and English coverage is what international investors and acquirers actually read.
candidates.access_status: free news tier plus free membership; premium 'Insights' behind subscription; newsletters (daily, weekly, events)
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted_editorial; premium tier must not be circumvented
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the country tag page and subscribe to the daily newsletter. Treat the free news layer as the monitoring surface; evaluate the paid Insights tier separately if deal-database coverage is needed.

candidates.source_name: The Recursive — Czech Republic and fintech tags
candidates.why_relevant: CEE-focused English-language tech media ('Meet the world's next tech leaders before anyone else'), with confirmed dedicated tags for Czech Republic (/tag/czech-republic/) and fintech (/tag/fintech/), country tags across the region for comparison, a reports hub at /reports/ and a weekly CEE roundup at /tag/cee-startup-amp-tech-weekly/. The cross-tag intersection (Czech Republic x fintech) is the precise slice this cell needs in English, and the regional framing lets Czech payments developments be benchmarked against Poland and Romania.
candidates.access_status: open_web; reports section may gate some downloads
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll both tag feeds plus the CEE weekly roundup; harvest /reports/ for annual CEE funding datasets that give Czech deal counts in a comparable regional frame.

candidates.why_relevant: A long-standing Czech personal-finance and company-data portal that is a standard reference point for Czech banking and payment product coverage, and is widely cited. Included here as an unverified candidate: my fetch was refused before any content was returned, so its section structure, paywall status and fintech density are all unassessed. It should be re-probed with a browser-grade client before being accepted or rejected.
candidates.access_status: unverified — HTTP 403 on plain fetch; almost certainly live but bot-defended
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-attempt with a headless browser and realistic headers; if still refused, check for an RSS feed or contact the publisher about licensed access. Do not record as dead on this single refusal.
candidates.observed_blocker: The server returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body.

candidates.why_relevant: Czech investment-focused outlet, a plausible channel for coverage of listed Czech financial institutions, fund flows and fintech investment commentary — i.e. the investor-relations and earnings topics in this run's scope. Unverified: the fetch was refused before any content was returned, so nothing about its structure or current output is confirmed.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-probe with a headless browser; look for RSS. Deprioritise relative to HN/E15 unless it proves to carry distinct fintech content.
candidates.observed_blocker: The server returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body.

candidates.why_relevant: Czech e-commerce trade media, the natural home for coverage of payment gateways, checkout methods, BNPL and merchant payment integrations — the acceptance-side signal that neither the startup media nor the banking trade press covers well. Unverified: fetch refused with no body returned, so section structure and payments density are unconfirmed and this remains a hypothesis.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-probe with a headless browser and check for tag pages on 'platební brána', 'platební metody' and 'BNPL'. If accessible, this is a priority acceptance-side source worth promoting.
candidates.observed_blocker: The server returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body.

candidates.why_relevant: One of the largest Czech consumer-technology outlets, a likely carrier of mobile-wallet, contactless and banking-app coverage (the consumer-facing surface of payments innovation). Unverified: fetch refused with no body returned. Included as a hypothesis to re-probe, not as a confirmed source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-probe with a headless browser; check for RSS and for tag pages on 'platby' / 'bankovnictví'.
candidates.observed_blocker: The server returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body.

candidates.why_relevant: Live and actively publishing (homepage items timestamped minutes old at fetch), with sections /novinky/, /menove-pary/ and /fx-pruvodce/ and a newsletter. However the observed scope is FX, currency pairs and macro/market commentary rather than fintech, payments infrastructure or startup funding — it is a weak fit for this cell and is recorded mainly so the run does not re-discover and re-evaluate it. Marginal value as an FX/market-context source for cross-border payments pricing.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Optional low-frequency monitoring of /novinky/ only if FX context is needed for cross-border payments analysis; otherwise skip.

negative_findings.description: WebSearch was unavailable for the entire run: the first two search calls (the Czech-language seeds 'CzechCrunch fintech investice platby startup kolo financování' and 'Lupa.cz platební technologie banka fintech') both returned 'this session has used its web search budget (200 of 200 WebSearch calls)'. No search engine query — Czech or English — could be executed at any point.
negative_findings.result_summary: All discovery in this slice was done by direct HTTP fetch of hypothesised or snowballed URLs, plus one on-site search (cc.cz/?s=fintech). Roughly 30 URLs were fetched. Czech-language coverage was still achieved — Czech terms were used against on-site search and Czech tag paths (/n/fintech/, /n/platby/, /n/bankovnictvi/, /tag/fintech/) — but no engine-mediated Czech-language discovery took place.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Direct fetching only finds sources you can already guess the domain of. Small Czech fintech blogs, personal Substack-style newsletters, LinkedIn-native commentators and independent podcasts are exactly the long-tail this cell was scoped to catch, and they are effectively invisible without a search engine. The slice is therefore biased toward large, well-known outlets and should be re-run once the search budget is restored.

negative_findings.description: CzechCrunch does not appear to expose a dedicated fintech tag or topic archive. https://cc.cz/tema/fintech/ returned homepage-style content rather than a tag archive (a soft 404), and the confirmed rubric list from the homepage (/byznys/, /startupy/, /tech/, /investice/, /e-commerce/, /krypto/, /umela-inteligence/ and others) contains no fintech rubric.
negative_findings.result_summary: No /tema/fintech/ or /fintech/ archive could be confirmed. On-site search at https://cc.cz/?s=fintech works and returns 38 results with /page/N/?s= pagination, and is the recommended substitute.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection design that assumes a stable CzechCrunch fintech tag URL will silently collect nothing. Monitoring must instead combine the /live/ wire, the /byznys/ + /startupy/ + /investice/ rubrics, and repeated keyword searches.

negative_findings.description: https://cc.cz/eventy/fintech-week-cee-2026/ appeared in CzechCrunch on-site search results for 'fintech', but fetching it returned the general CzechCrunch events index (People, Money Maker Praha, Longevity Festival 2027, Future 2027, CzechCrunch X, plus supported events) with no Fintech Week CEE content at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fintech Week CEE 2026 could not be confirmed as a CzechCrunch-hosted event page; no organiser, date, venue, speaker or partner list was obtained. The URL is recorded as unverified, not dead — search results referencing it suggest it existed at some point.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fintech Week CEE would be a strong pointer source (organiser, sponsor and speaker lists are a ready-made actor map for CEE payments). It should be re-chased directly on its own domain once search is available, rather than through CzechCrunch.

negative_findings.description: https://ceftas.visualbook.pro/, linked from the Czech Fintech Association's projects page, was hypothesised to be a fintech company map or directory. It is not — it is the association's brand and visual identity guidebook (logos, typography, colours, naming conventions, contact ondra@czechfintech.cz), available in Czech, Slovak and English.
negative_findings.result_summary: No fintech company map, catalogue or landscape graphic was found on the association's site. The usable actor lists are the member directory at /clenove/ (80+ members) and the CzechTrade export brochure at /project/10647/ (200+ active firms).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a downstream collector from wasting effort parsing a brand style guide as a company database, and redirects effort to the two lists that actually contain company names.

negative_findings.description: A 'FinTech Roadmap' podcast was hypothesised as a Czech Fintech Association partnership and specifically searched for on both https://czechfintech.cz/clanky/ and https://czechfintech.cz/projekty/. Neither page mentions it. The association's confirmed projects are the Studie českého fintechu, the Enterprise Investment Scheme (EIS) initiative, and the CzechTrade export brochure.
negative_findings.result_summary: No association-run podcast confirmed. More broadly, no dedicated Czech-language fintech-only podcast was verified anywhere in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell brief explicitly names 'fintech-focused blogs and podcasts' as a target. The podcasts actually confirmed are general-business (CzechCrunch Money Maker, 201 eps), general-tech (Lupa.cz podcast), and adjacent HN shows (MoneyPenny on personal finance, Krypto Insider on crypto). The dedicated Czech fintech podcast layer is currently an unfilled gap, not a covered one.

negative_findings.description: The StartupJobs.cz magazine path https://www.startupjobs.cz/magazin returned HTTP 404. The blog at https://www.startupjobs.cz/blog does exist and is live, but its content is HR-focused — hiring, interviews, compensation, workplace culture, monthly labour-market notes (e.g. /blog/clanek/co-cervenec-posunul-vpred-7-26).
negative_findings.result_summary: No coverage of Czech startup funding rounds, capital raises or company launches was found on the StartupJobs blog. It does not belong in a funding/launch monitoring pipeline.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: StartupJobs is a plausible-looking startup-ecosystem property that would waste a collection slot. Its residual value is as a hiring-signal source (a payments startup posting many roles is a growth signal), which is a different workstream from A1.

negative_findings.description: SMARTmania.cz (Czech consumer tech portal, founded 2005, redakce@smartmania.cz) was probed as a possible mobile-payments channel (Apple Pay, Google Pay, banking apps). The retrieved homepage showed only smartphones, smartwatches, keyboards, drones and automotive content, with categories under /kategorie/recenze/ and a product catalogue at /katalog/.
negative_findings.result_summary: No evidence of payments, banking-app or Czech bank launch coverage was found. Registration-gated perks exist but no paywall or RSS was visible.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Rules out one of the obvious consumer-tech candidates for wallet/contactless coverage and narrows where that signal actually lives — Lupa.cz /n/platby/ carried the contactless-wearables story (Huawei watches, 13.4.2026) instead.

negative_findings.description: Five plausible Czech sources returned HTTP 403 Forbidden with no response body on a single plain fetch each: https://www.penize.cz/, https://www.investicniweb.cz/, https://www.zive.cz/, https://www.ecommercebridge.cz/ and https://finmag.cz/. A 403 with no body is the signature of bot protection, not of a dead site.
negative_findings.result_summary: All five are recorded as blocked=true and unverified rather than dead. Four are carried as candidates with reduced confidence (0.30-0.35); Finmag.cz is recorded here only, as nothing at all about its current structure could be confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If these are logged as dead, the run permanently loses the merchant-acceptance angle (Ecommerce Bridge) and two significant consumer-finance archives. They must be re-probed with a headless browser or realistic headers before any liveness verdict is issued.

negative_findings.description: Two domains failed below the HTTP layer rather than returning a status code: https://tyinternety.cz/ failed with 'connect ECONNREFUSED 167.99.132.26:443' (DNS resolved, TLS connection refused), and https://depo.ventures/ failed with 'getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND depo.ventures' (no DNS record at all).
negative_findings.result_summary: TyInternety.cz — a Czech digital/marketing trade title — could not be assessed. Depo Ventures, hypothesised as a publisher of a Czech startup funding report, has no resolving domain under that name; the Czech startup funding report hypothesis is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ENOTFOUND is materially stronger evidence than a 403 — the depo.ventures guess was almost certainly just a wrong domain, so the Czech VC-published funding-report layer remains entirely unexplored. TyInternety needs one retry before any conclusion; a single ECONNREFUSED can be transient or geo/IP-specific.

negative_findings.description: Forbes Česko (forbes.cz) — an outlet named explicitly in this coverage cell — returned essentially empty bodies on three separate paths: the homepage, /technologie/ and /tag/fintech/. Each returned only a title/header line ('Forbes | I jedna věta vám může změnit život!', and for the tag page 'Fintech ▶ ... s Forbes Česko | Forbes'), with no navigation, no article list and no URLs.
negative_findings.result_summary: Confirmed: HTTP 200 responses and a /tag/<slug>/ URL pattern with a fintech tag that resolves. Unconfirmed: rubric structure, article inventory, paywall model, newsletters, podcasts, RSS.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Forbes CZ is a named target of this cell and cannot be collected with a plain HTTP client. Any pipeline must budget for headless rendering, or find a sitemap/RSS bypass, before Forbes coverage can be claimed.

negative_findings.description: The glossary used in this run was assembled ad hoc from observed page navigation rather than from a systematic Czech terminology build, because no search engine was available to test term productivity. Terms actually exercised: fintech, fintechové startupy, platby, platební brána, platební metody, bezkontaktní platby, bankovnictví, banky, účty a platby, kreditní/charge karty, startupy, investice, kolo financování, evidence tržeb/EET, sandbox, tiskové zprávy, členové, rozhovor, podcast.
negative_findings.result_summary: Several important Czech terms were never exercised against any index: 'platební instituce', 'poskytovatel platebních služeb', 'licence ČNB', 'akvizice', 'akvirer', 'terminál', 'POS terminál', 'mobilní peněženka', 'okamžité platby', 'PSD2', 'otevřené bankovnictví'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Noisy-vs-productive term classification is unvalidated. 'Platby' in particular is high-recall but noisy (it surfaced Apple subscription revenue and a DDoS story alongside genuine payments-infrastructure news), while 'platební instituce' and 'licence ČNB' are likely high-precision and were never tested. The glossary must be rebuilt and tested when search is restored.

coverage_gaps.description: No search-engine-mediated discovery was possible in this run (WebSearch budget exhausted before the first call). Every source here was reached by guessing a domain or by snowballing from an already-known page, which structurally favours large incumbent outlets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with WebSearch available, executing the six seed queries plus extensions, and specifically hunt the long tail: independent Czech fintech newsletters, Substack/LinkedIn-native commentators, and single-host podcasts. Treat the current slice as an incumbent-outlet baseline, not as complete coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: The 'fintech-focused podcasts' half of this cell is essentially unfilled. Only general-business and general-tech shows were confirmed (CzechCrunch Money Maker, Lupa.cz podcast, HN's MoneyPenny and Krypto Insider). No dedicated Czech fintech or payments podcast was verified, and the hypothesised association-linked 'FinTech Roadmap' show was not found on the association's site.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search Czech podcast directories directly (Spotify, Apple Podcasts, mujRozhlas, Podbean) for 'fintech', 'platby', 'bankovnictví', 'finanční technologie'. Also check whether the Czech Fintech Association, ČSOB/Mastercard Fintech Challenge, or Fintech Week CEE run companion audio.

coverage_gaps.description: Six named targets could not be read: Forbes.cz (JS-rendered, empty bodies on three paths) plus five HTTP 403s (Peníze.cz, Investiční web, Živě.cz, Ecommerce Bridge CZ, Finmag.cz). Forbes CZ is named directly in the cell brief and Ecommerce Bridge is the only merchant-acceptance-side title identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a headless-browser fetch path to the collection stack and re-probe all six. For each, first check for sitemap.xml and RSS, which often bypass both JS rendering and bot walls. Do not mark any of them dead on the current evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: Four confirmed sources in this cell run subscription tiers whose gated content was never assessed: Hospodářské noviny+ (predplatne.hn.cz), e15 Premium (/e15-premium), Lupa+ (/podporte/), and the print/digital edition of Časopis Bankovnictví (/predplatne). The gated layer is likely where the substantive banking and vendor detail sits.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cost out subscriptions for HN+ and Časopis Bankovnictví as the two highest-value paid tiers for Czech banking and payments, and confirm each publisher's terms on machine collection of subscribed content before ingesting. Never circumvent a paywall.

coverage_gaps.description: Every confirmed outlet is Prague-centred national media. No regional Czech startup or tech media were identified — Brno (a substantial tech hub, and the venue for the CryptoNight event the association listed), Ostrava and Plzeň all have startup ecosystems whose local coverage was not probed at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe regional titles and hub publications (e.g. JIC Brno, TechTower Ostrava, regional Deník business sections) for payments/fintech content once search is restored. Regional coverage is where a young company appears before national media notices it — precisely this cell's stated weak-signal rationale.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage of Czech payments rests on two pan-regional outlets (Tech.eu, The Recursive) whose Czech output is intermittent and skewed toward VC deal news. No Czech-domiciled English-language business publication was identified, and CzechCrunch showed no English edition in the structure retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe for English editions or English tags on Czech outlets, and check whether Czech banks, payment institutions and the Czech Fintech Association publish English press rooms directly — for A1 disclosure topics, an English IR/press page on the actor's own site would be a direct source and outrank both aggregators.

coverage_gaps.description: No Czech VC-published or data-provider-published funding report was located. The depo.ventures hypothesis failed at DNS, and no equivalent Czech startup funding report publisher was confirmed. CzechStartups.gov.cz has a /startup-data/ path that was seen referenced but not itself retrieved and parsed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse https://czechstartups.gov.cz/startup-data/ directly, and identify Czech VC funds that publish periodic ecosystem reports (via the /startup-ekosystem/investori/ directory, which lists 44 investors). A quantified Czech fintech funding series would anchor the qualitative media signal from this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The Czech terminology used was derived from site navigation rather than tested for precision and recall. High-precision regulatory and acceptance-side terms — 'platební instituce', 'poskytovatel platebních služeb', 'licence ČNB', 'akvirer', 'POS terminál', 'okamžité platby', 'otevřené bankovnictví', 'PSD2' — were never run against any index, while the high-recall term 'platby' demonstrably returns noise.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build and empirically test a two-tier Czech glossary (high-precision regulatory/technical terms vs high-recall broad terms) against Lupa's /n/ archives and CzechCrunch on-site search, recording hit counts and false-positive rates per term before wiring any keyword filter into production collection.

brief: Czech fintech and payments weak signals concentrate in a small number of Prague-based outlets, and Lupa.cz is the clear anchor: it maintains genuine, actively-updated Czech-language topic archives at /n/fintech/ (101 articles), /n/platby/ (127) and /n/bankovnictvi/ (34), plus a verified RSS 2.0 feed, making it the cheapest high-yield ingestion point in this cell. CzechCrunch has the greater reach and the faster wire — its timestamped /live/ feed carries fintech launch and partnership items several times a day — but it exposes no fintech tag archive, so it must be worked through section indexes and on-site search instead. Around that core sit the Czech Fintech Association (an 80+ member directory and a 200+ firm export brochure, the best actor-map pointers found), the trade title Časopis Bankovnictví with its distinctive /personalie/ executive-move feed, the state CzechStartups.gov.cz directories, and English-language regional coverage via Tech.eu and The Recursive. Two caveats bound this slice hard: WebSearch was exhausted before the first query, so nothing was found by search engine and the long tail of independent Czech fintech blogs, newsletters and podcasts remains undiscovered; and six targets including the cell-named Forbes.cz could not be read (JS rendering or HTTP 403) and are recorded as unverified hypotheses, not as dead.
